input.question: Review this change for security defects only (not style, not simplification). For each defect give its location as file:line in the new version of the file, a category, a severity, and why it is exploitable or harmful. Report no finding when the change is secure.

target.rationale: Seeded defects listed below; a good review reports each of them and no false positives of weight.

items.description: The deny-list drops "d" (private exponent / EC private key) and "k" (symmetric key): an RSA or EC private key, or a symmetric key, is published at the unauthenticated JWKS path.
Private key member values are written to the log at DEBUG.

grading.judge: a judge model without tools (claude-sonnet-5-5) sees question, facts, target.items and the answer, and returns the items met with a score from 0 to 1

history: 2026-10-04: written by hand against the real code of the named file(s) at the named commit, with the seeded defects listed in target.items.
2026-10-04: taken into the corpus; the reference confirmed by the operator.
